wllama — WebAssembly binding for llama.cpp
https://github.com/ngxson/wllama

Vendored files (committed as static assets, not fetched at runtime):
  wllama.esm.js   from @wllama/wllama@3.5.1, esm/index.js (unminified, unmodified)
  wllama.wasm     from @wllama/wllama@3.5.1, esm/wasm/wllama.wasm (unmodified)

Fetched via `npm pack @wllama/wllama@3.5.1` from the public npm registry and
extracted locally. Not modified beyond copying out of the package tarball.

License: MIT (see LICENSE in this directory).

Why vendored instead of loaded from a CDN: this site never makes requests to
any host the visitor didn't knowingly trigger themselves. See
sites/local-llm/public/demo.js for the one deliberate deviation from the
library's own default behavior — wllama defaults to a CDN-hosted
compatibility fallback (jsdelivr) for browsers lacking WebAssembly JSPI /
Memory64 support; that fallback is explicitly disabled here
(`wllama.setCompat(null)`) so the page never fetches anything from jsdelivr.
Browsers that would have needed that fallback simply can't run this demo —
see the in-page note next to the demo for what that means in practice.
